title: Analyse marketing performance
description: Verify definitions, attribution, duplication and period comparability.
accomplishes: Verify definitions, attribution, duplication and period comparability. Separate observations, possible explanations and decisions. Relate costs to quality and sales stages. Give three actions with review conditions, and do not calculate ratios without their denominators.
prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Analyse marketing performance.

Input context:
- REPORT: [REPORT]
- OBJECTIVE: [OBJECTIVE]
- PERIOD: [PERIOD]
- CHANGES: [CHANGES]

Verify definitions, attribution, duplication and period comparability. Separate observations, possible explanations and decisions. Relate costs to quality and sales stages. Give three actions with review conditions, and do not calculate ratios without their denominators.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Incomplete-report interpretation
Spend and enquiries are supplied but qualification is missing. Cost per enquiry may be calculable after deduplication; profitability and cost per customer are not established. Connect enquiries to CRM stages, exclude internal tests and compare consistent periods. Keep a missing-data column instead of replacing unknown values with zero. No unsupported return on investment is claimed.
